description: Read the Doctor’s posted parlays for one league (e.g. LGUE_nfl): 2-3 legs on different games, each B+ or better when posted. Upcoming first with the newest regrade (currentGrade), then recent WON/LOST/PUSH results and the parlays record. Items carry parlayType (lock = 2 legs, moonshot = 3), title, pitch, legCount, oddsAmerican (combined price) and netUnits once settled. Empty means nothing cleared the bar today. App permissions and paid-leg lock apply; a paid reader gets the legs to put the parlay on a slip.
name: get_doctor_parlays
title: Read Doctor parlays
